assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent standalone OUTER BORDER ornament for the supplied metallic hexagonal achievement badge.
Reference image: Image 1 is a shape and metal-finish reference. Create an additional external armor rim that will sit BEHIND that existing badge. Do not redraw the badge.
Primary request: a polished silver chrome DOUBLE-BEVELED HEXAGONAL RING with six understated reinforced angular corner joints. It is a point-up six-sided ring: one vertex at top center, one at bottom center, two perfectly vertical side segments, four diagonal segments. Overall width-to-height ratio approximately 0.9, precisely centered and mirror-symmetric front elevation. Its empty inner aperture has the same point-up hexagon proportions and takes about 84 percent of its outer width. The ring thickness stays refined, about 5–7 percent of its width. Strong broad bevels, one narrow dark inset channel, and small angular corner caps create a clear upgrade from the original plain rim without becoming spiky.
Material: neutral grayscale silver/chrome only, bright polished edge highlights, medium-gray metallic faces, dark inset edges, matching the reference's faceted geometry. Clean video-game achievement insignia rendering.
Backdrop and interior: ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA both outside the ring and throughout the entire central hexagonal opening. The central opening is completely empty; it is NOT a dark filled panel.
Composition: single upright ring, complete outer points and comfortable transparent margins; no crop, no perspective tilt.
Constraints: ONLY the independent hollow border. No badge face, no wings, no crest, no crown, no text, no gems, no plate, no laurels, no glow or shadows outside the metal, no watermark. No background. Six-sided hexagon, NOT eight sides.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a blank wide hexagonal achievement badge concept for website text overlay.
Reference image: Image 1 is a material and bevel-style reference only. Make a new wider silhouette.
Primary request: one HORIZONTAL elongated six-sided hexagonal badge, resembling a wide rectangular nameplate with a shallow triangular point at each end. Exactly SIX outer corners: top-left shoulder, top-right shoulder, right central point, bottom-right shoulder, bottom-left shoulder, left central point. Long perfectly horizontal top and bottom edges; four short angled end edges; NO vertical sides. Outer width about 2.7 times height. The long central rectangular text region spans at least 75 percent of the width.
Finish: refined beveled GOLD metallic rim with sharp white specular highlights, a thin recessed dark inner channel, matching the reference's polished faceted game-badge style. Face is opaque dark charcoal black with very subtle angular faceting and low-contrast shading. Keep the entire central text area dark, even, and uncluttered.
Composition: straight-on orthographic front view, exact bilateral symmetry, landscape orientation, centered isolated badge, complete outline with minimal comfortable transparent margins. One single badge only, filling the image width.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside the badge; opaque dark charcoal face inside.
Constraints: blank center, absolutely NO text or numerals baked in, no icons, no plate, no wings, no crest, no crown, no laurels, no gems, no drop shadow outside the badge, no watermark. Do not reproduce the reference's tall point-up hexagon; this is a LOW WIDE plaque with a point at the LEFT and RIGHT. Six sides, not an octagon.
